'''Quadrant T-15''' was a section of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] filled with textile manufacturing units. [[Republic Treasury/Legends|Republic Treasury]] agent [[Besany Wennen]] once went there looking for the office of [[Dhannut Logistics]].<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
